nom: COSRX Oil-Free Ultra-Moisturizing Lotion with Birch Sap

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin most often describe this lotion as lightweight, fast-absorbing and non-greasy, with several calling it their best moisturizer for oily skin, though a few report it left them shiny, sweaty, or with visible pores and whiteheads by end of day.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin generally report good hydration and relief from flaking or tightness, though some note it is not moisturizing enough on its own during winter or very dry periods.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin frequently describe it as balancing oily and dry areas well without pilling, though a few found it too lightweight to fully hydrate their drier patches or reported breakouts on the chin and forehead.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are split: many describe it as calming, non-irritating and free of breakouts even with reactive or eczema-prone skin, while others report burning, itching, stinging or an allergic-type reaction attributed to fragrance or essential oils.
segments.normal: The few reviewers describing normal skin report smooth absorption and improved hydration without issues.
segments.mature: Reviewers with mature skin describe it as effective and good value even compared to expensive luxury moisturizers, helping with hydration and calming acne-prone mature skin.

concerns.aging: Two reviewers over 45-50 report good results, including one who calls it great value versus expensive anti-aging lines and another who says it plumps and calms aging, acne-prone skin.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers with oily-dehydrated or combination-dehydrated skin report the product hydrates well without adding oiliness; a couple say it is not hydrating enough for their needs, especially in colder months.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers mention it calms redness and inflammation, including one citing birch sap specifically for reducing inflammation, and another reporting improvement with rosacea.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers recovering from over-exfoliation, chemical peels or reactive skin report it calmed inflammation and irritation quickly; one reviewer had a stinging/dryness reaction despite the birch sap.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports improvement in pigmentation and uneven tone over time; another reports gradual reduction of psoriasis spots on the face and body.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers with acne-prone skin report fewer breakouts, calmer skin and no purging over weeks to months of use; however, several others report new whiteheads, cystic acne or painful pimples, particularly on the chin, forehead, and cheeks.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers with oily skin report it controls shine and reduces oiliness throughout the day without feeling heavy; a minority report the opposite, describing greasiness, a shiny or 'glazed donut' look, or worsened oiliness in humidity.

aspects.libelle: Herbal or tea tree scent liked

extraits.texte: I started using this product 2 months ago and I broke out from it pretty badly. I got a combination of whiteheads and cycstic acne. I have combo skin and i would get really oily with this moisturizer. I wanted to like the product because its oil free. I mostly broke out on my chin and forehead.

I have oily acne prone sensitive skin Ive tried this product in my face and throught the day I got so sweaty and at the end of the day I looked like a hydrated glazed donut and you could even see my pores and I got a lot of white heads from the oil. definitely good for dry skin. If you put it into your hands or other parte of your body you would be so soft and its such a nice feeling I also love the scent.

I have oily but dehydrated skin, and upright dry around my cheeks. I've been on the search for a moisturizer than would hydrate my skin but not leave me greasy. I read the reviews for this and I thought it would work well for the issue. This seemed to do wonders for other people but It was mediocre for me. It provided light hydration but not enough for my skin, and on top of that it never truly absorbs into my skin. My skin feels tacky for an hour or two after applying, which leads to pilling when I apply sunscreen. My skin didn't react negatively to it though, and I'm almost done with the bottle. I'm hoping it will fare better in the summertime.

extraits.titre: Holy grail for sensitive, combo skin
extraits.texte: I have extremely sensitive combination skin. I am also acne prone. My skin is so sensitive that most products immediately inflame and burn my face. The only face lotion that worked with my skin before I found this was the La Roche Posay double repair in matte. The down sides of the double repair were constant pilling (especially towards the end of the bottle and with makeup on) and smaller size (75ml). I was stoked when I saw this lotion in store, as I've loved all COSRX products I've tried. It has surpassed all of my expectations! The smell is really gentle and dissipates quickly. It is so moisturizing and has not caused any irritation or breakouts. There's zero pilling, too! This will be my go to daytime face lotion from now on.

extraits.titre: Holy Grail for Mature / Acne Prone Skin
extraits.texte: Astounding formulation & feels heavenly on skin. My 50+ skin is STILL very acne prone & flips btwn dry & slightly oily. This ACTUALLY moisturizes & calms my crazy skin. LOVE IT, plus layers REALLY well with other products

I bought this moisturizer a few months ago because I wanted something calming, light, non comodogenic, hydrating, affordable, and with aesthetically pleasing & functional packaging. I have very sensitive, acne prone skin that gets extremely irritated by BHAs and most AHAs, and past "sensitive skin" moisturizers have never performed very well when irritation would flare up. This lotion however, performs Perfectly. The few times I have been overzealous in exfoliating over the past few months, this product has calmed down the inflammation within about 15 seconds, and has never reacted poorly when combined with other products. The texture is light, and never leaves my face sticky. I've also only used about 20% of the bottle in 3 months, so a little goes a long way. My skin hasn't felt tight/dry in months, and the product absorbs well. The packaging is also great; I don't like moisturizers in tubs or tubes because the likelihood of contaminating the product during use is so much higher, so the pump on this lotion is a plus. And one final pro - CosRX doesn't test on animals! I will literally never purchase a different mositurizer again.

extraits.titre: Heavy fragrance triggered immediate allergic reaction
extraits.texte: The smell of this lotion is SO intense - more powerful than ever normal highly fragranced cream (this puts Lush, Bath and Bodyworks and The Body Shop to shame), and the most powerful I've ever come across for a face cream. It smells like a full bag of gummy bears! I honestly should have put this down there and then, but curiosity killed the cat (my skin). I loved the texture, how it spread and was gel like and made the skin super dewy and plump. But I could only enjoy that for 10-15 seconds before my eyes started burning and my face got hot and itchy. As a last ditch attempt I used my Tower 28 skin rescue spray and a Laneige cica sleep mask to verify it was not just my skin needing some extra tlc but actually having an allergic reaction. So I immediately had to deep cleanse my entire face and neck with a handy Peach and Lily cleanser sample I had on my sink and put my recovery skin care on instead of my regular routine I had just done before putting this cream on. Unfortunately I learnt the hard way that I am part of the population that is highly intolerant to natural fragrance (I had an identical reaction to a Pacifica sunscreen spray that has only "natural/clean essential oil" ingredients and fragrance or/ and to skin contact with birch sap (as a precaution I will simply assume I am allergic to keep my skin safe until I can get medically tested).
